They stole his joy. He went to obtain a birth certificate for the twins Aser and Aysel - 4 days later. He returned and they were martyred along with their mother. What pain does it have to hold the birth certificate and death certificate of your children on the same day? God is sufficient for us, and He is the best disposer of affairs 💔 💔 💔 💔

For forty days and nights, the Western media lamented the lie of Israeli children with their heads cut off, with which the occupation deceived the world, and they did not see a single picture confirming its claims... while every day the headless children of Gaza appear to us in painful pictures, without their weeping, and the media biased towards the occupation and complicit in the crime does not dare. 💔 💔 💔 💔 😭 😭 😭 😭 😭 😭 😭 😭 😭 😭 😭 😭 😭 😭 😭 😭 😭 😭 😭 😭 😭

As usual, a large number are killed when the disaster strikes, and another number gradually succumbs to their wounds after it occurs. Omar Al-Jaabari, 13 years old, died of his wounds at Kamal Adwan Hospital. He was among the victims of the massacre at Al-Tabaeen School two days ago. Omar suffered severe burns as a result of the American missiles that produce very high temperatures, and he was not directly injured, otherwise he would have been turned into pieces and his body would have melted. 💔 💔 💔
Imagine for a moment in time that this is your child? How would you feel about the Zionists?

Oh the beauty of your eyes, this is the head of the angel child Osama Abu Al-Nada, which Israel cut off yesterday. Osama was martyred with his father, Taha Abu Al-Nada, his mother, Hoda, and his brothers, Nour, Dana, Ghani, and Jana.
